subject: [PATCH 06/60] mm/memory_hotplug: migrate offlined pages to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted the original patch and provided a detailed explanation of the problem and proposed solution. The code change restricts hot-unplug migration targets to N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes, ensuring that only reachable nodes are considered for allocation.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to migrate offlined pages to common memory, addressing a limitation in the current code where migration is restricted to N_MEMORY nodes. The goal is to allow hot-unplug migration targets to reflect only the nodes that the allocator can reach.
